citrine-signal.$description: Citrine Signal — Primary action buttons, brand cube fills, accent icon strokes, decorative 3D cubes, featured logo marks — the single chromatic voice of the system

carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Page canvas, primary text on light sections, dominant border color, button fills on reversed (light) sections

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Primary text on dark canvas, nav and body text, light icon fills, ghost button text

graphite.$description: Graphite — Elevated surface above carbon, secondary panels, darker card variants

ash.$description: Ash — Muted card surface, tertiary background layers behind content blocks

stone.$description: Stone — Muted body text, secondary link text, low-priority borders, helper labels

smoke.$description: Smoke — Dividers, subtle borders, decorative strokes in illustrations

chalk.$description: Chalk — Card borders on dark sections, hairline dividers between content blocks

cream-paper.$description: Cream Paper — Light section background — the single warm reversal that breaks the dark rhythm

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Maximum contrast text, logo silhouettes, hard-edge decorative fills

sand.$description: Sand — Warm-tinted decorative fills, illustration accents — the only chromatic neutral

neue-haas-grotesk-text.$description: Sole typeface across the entire system. Weight 400 carries body, nav, and most UI; weight 500 reserved for emphasized labels and button text. Display headlines at 80px with 0.90 line-height create the signature monolithic rows. Small labels (10–12px) use positive tracking (+0.020 to +0.032em) to read as uppercase utility marks. The humanist geometry of Haas Grotesk — slightly humanist terminals, even stroke contrast — gives the dark interface a warm, editorial quality rather than feeling like a terminal.
